text: {"lessons":["With no trades, my account still rose and fell; I should not mistake short-term market swings for a signal I can predict.","My account value ended above where it began despite several declines, reminding me that a few monthly changes are not enough to judge a long-term decision.","When I review my holdings, I should make deliberate choices based on my plan and each stock’s prospects—not my average cost or reluctance to admit a mistake."]}
